prompt: Build a 5-qubit circuit implementing, as a general-purpose circuit block: Hadamard on all 5 qubits, then the phase exp(-i*gamma*H) where H = sum over weighted edges of w_ij * Z_i * Z_j. Graph (a star centered on qubit 0): edge (0,1) weight 0.5, edge (0,2) weight -0.3, edge (0,3) weight 0.8, edge (0,4) weight 0.2. gamma = 0.4. Any correct implementation of the phase term is accepted (Z_i*Z_j is diagonal, so any gate sequence producing the same phase per computational basis state is correct — it does not need to match one specific decomposition). No measurement.
